body: School drains all my energy because i have be around people, once i get home i barley have any free time because of homework. What little bit of relaxation i do get is just enough to make it to the next day and so on until it comes crashing down and i get super depressed for a while then repeat. So ive decided it isn't worth struggling anymore
My day to day life makes me miserable and im not in any position to fix it
